config.description: One FRED API series/observations request per configured monthly LAUS county alias (6,282: laus_monthly_unemployment_rate 3,141; laus_monthly_labor_force 3,141), each over the full real-time window 1776-07-04..9999-12-31 so every ALFRED vintage comes back as [realtime_start, realtime_end] spans. Series and their county codes are discovered by build_config.py from FRED release 116 and GeoFRED; the series_id list here must equal config.json (build_config.py --emit-parameters regenerates it). A series FRED does not archive answers 400 "does not exist in ALFRED" and is recorded as skipped. desired_bytes is 1.8 GiB against a declared 2 GiB ceiling for this dataset: 20 sampled full-window payloads measured 174.7 KiB mean for the unemployment rate and 313.7 KiB mean for the labor force, which extrapolates to 1.43 GiB for the two families together.

source.originating_source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, Local Area Unemployment Statistics (county, monthly, not seasonally adjusted)
